description:
易排 OpenAI Plugin formats Markdown into WeChat Official Account HTML with a phone-width preview. Copy the result and paste it into the Official Account editor, the same way mdnice works. Free output includes a 易排 OpenAI Plugin line. The plugin does not publish articles.

Starter prompts

1. Format this Markdown for a WeChat Official Account and show a preview. Do not save a draft.
2. Restyle the last WeChat preview with the tech theme.
3. Give me WeChat-ready HTML I can paste into the Official Account editor.
